name: Increased Spell Maximum
body:
You have focused greater attention on your arcane studies than most archons, and thus can learn a greater number of spells.

Prerequisite: 1st–level Archon.

Benefit: Your maximum spells known for each spell level increases by 1. You still must learn these spells normally, they are not automatically gained by taking this feat.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, its effects stack.
